workflow.name: Link Availability Checker
workflow.description: Perform availability checks on a set of URLs: prioritize HEAD probing, automatically fallback to GET when necessary, and generate a Markdown report.

meta.name: Link Availability Checker
meta.description: Perform availability checks on a set of URLs: prioritize HEAD probing, automatically fallback to GET when necessary, and generate a Markdown report.

steps.name: Prepare Target Links
HEAD Probe
GET Fallback
Merge Results
Generate Markdown Report

targets.title: Targets (URL array)
targets.description: An array of URL strings. Each item can be a full http/https URL, or a shorthand like example.com (we'll auto-prefix https://).

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of links to probe simultaneously (default 5). If encountering timeouts or rate limiting, decrease it.

followRedirects.title: Follow Redirects
followRedirects.description: Default true: automatically follow 301/302 redirects, final URL will be recorded in results.

maxTargets.title: Maximum Links to Check
maxTargets.description: Prevent too many inputs causing long runtime (default 50).

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: UA string when making requests. Some sites decide whether to allow access based on UA.

examples.name: Documentation/Dependency Site Check (Real Requests, Dozens of URLs)
examples.description: Input JSON array string (dozens of real URLs) for real probing and generate report artifact.

results.title: Check Results
results.description: Output final check results for each URL in input order (HEAD or GET fallback override).

report_md.title: Markdown Report Content
report_md.description: Markdown report that can be directly copied to issue/PR/Feishu/DingTalk/Notion.

file_name.title: Report File Name
file_name.description: Markdown file name written to artifacts.

wrote_file.title: File Written
wrote_file.description: Whether successfully written and registered artifacts.

meta.title: Execution Meta
meta.description: Contains errors/warnings and artifact write information.
